description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Custom3DPrint" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/custom3dprint">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Instruction" name="Instruction to create project"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Changes" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Project" name="Project result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_STL" name="STL file"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instruct" name="Instruct artist" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Send sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Send requested changes" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Project" name="Project result" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Event_ReceiveResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="STL file" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Event_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Status" name="Printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Need for custom 3D model">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create project" messageRef="Msg_Instruction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send several sketches to artist" messageRef="Msg_Sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeResult" name="Merge result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveResult" name="Receive project from artist">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReceiveResult" messageRef="Msg_Project"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewResult" name="Review result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with result?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Msg_Changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL file from artist">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Msg_STL"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Color in stock at home?" default="Flow_13">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_CheckAmount" name="Check remaining plastic amount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Less than 100 grams left?" default="Flow_16">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put plastic on shopping list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergePlastic" name="Plastic available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start printer setup and G-code generation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatUp" name="Turn on printer and heat up bed and extruder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStatus" name="Receive printer status during heating" messageRef="Msg_PrinterStatus">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Heated" name="Bed and extruder at target temperature?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code file from STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Printer ready and G-code generated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Printed" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeResult" targetRef="Event_ReceiveResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveResult" targetRef="Task_ReviewResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_ReviewResult" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!satisfied}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Event_ReceiveSTL">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="ManualTask_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_OrderColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="ManualTask_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remainingGrams < 100}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_MergePlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_MergePlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Gateway_MergePlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_MergePlastic" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_HeatUp" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Heated" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${heated}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="EndEvent_Printed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatus" targetRef="Gateway_Heated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Heated" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatus">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!heated}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Status">
      <bpmn:text>Printer continuously sends its status back during heating</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_Status" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatus" targetRef="TextAnnotation_Status"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
